title: Guessing Game Setup
story: You're building a guessing game for your friends. Instead of picking a secret number yourself, you let the computer surprise you every single time!
why: Random numbers make programs unpredictable and fun — they're the heart of every game.
analogy: Random number generation is like rolling dice — you never know what you'll get, but you know it'll be within a certain range.
try_it: Change the range to 1-100 and run it a few times. See how the numbers get bigger! Then try 1-1000 for even more variety.
tips: `math.random_range(min, max)` includes both ends — so `random_range(1, 10)` can return 1 AND 10
Run your program multiple times to see different random results each time
Always store the random result in a variable so you can use it later
common_mistakes: Forgetting to store the result — `math.random_range(1, 10);` without a variable means the random number is lost
Thinking the first run is 'the' answer — random means different every time you run the program
